Name: Always Full Watering Can
Author: BelLucifer
Description:
Never worry about running out of water again!  
This simple SMAPI mod automatically refills every watering can you own — including the one you're holding and any extras in your inventory. Works on all tiers, from the basic watering can to the iridium version.

⚙️ Requirements
- [SMAPI](https://smapi.io) 4.0.0 or higher
- Stardew Valley 1.6+

🔄 Compatibility
- Works in both single-player and multiplayer (host only).
- Should not conflict with most other mods.
- Safe to install or remove anytime.

Enjoy your endless water supply! 💧🌱

Manifest.Name: Always Full Watering Can
Manifest.Description: Automatically keeps all of your watering cans completely full at all times. On game startup and throughout gameplay, every watering can you own — from basic to iridium — will instantly refill so you never have to visit a water source again.
